تتعجرفون (form IIq)
# تَتَعَجْرَفُونَ (tataʕajrafūna) /ta.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُتَعَجْرَفُونَ (tutaʕajrafūna) /tu.ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
